source.title: Mokena D159 School Calendar 26.27.pdf
source.verification: The district's March 19, 2026 announcement states that the Board approved the 2026-2027 school-year calendar and links this PDF. source.transcription_policy: Preserve the published calendar categories. Do not infer dismissal times from color markers. Keep school-specific attendance exceptions distinct from district-wide closures.

source.time_policy: VEVENT DTSTART/DTEND values in this export are floating local values without TZID or UTC marker. Preserve as floating; do not assign a timezone to individual events solely from the VTIMEZONE component.
source.verification: Derived from the user-provided official district iCalendar export. Original event UIDs and source wording are retained below. Repeated entries remain represented in source_event_uids; this is a schedule-oriented reference view, not a destructive deduplication.

grouping_policy: Records are grouped only by identical inclusive date range to surface possible overlaps. A group is not an event identity. Different school scope, schedule type, attendance status, original wording, or source channel remain separate observations. Never merge records solely because dates overlap.
